maudry_first_meet: ^The woman at the Mule's door looks you over and goes on wiping a mug that was already clean.
^"Maudry Fenn. The Mule's mine. You'll be the one who came in off the road looking like the road came with you."

b: ^"Hold on. I know that frown. I knew your mother,
^. She'd have had words about those boots."
^"That's a Redhand way of standing. Don't look at me like that, I've poured for enough of them. Walked out, did you? Good. Keep walking in here and we'll get on."
^"Reedholm manners. The Sisters raised you, then. You'll be able to read, which puts you ahead of the Watch."
^"You shake hands like a Deepdelver. That's not a complaint. The last one who did that paid in advance."
^, is it. I'll remember. I remember everyone. It's the job."

s0: ^Maudry looks up from the tap. "Back again,
s1: ^"Still in one piece, I see. The Vale's getting careless."
s2: ^Maudry slides a mug your way without asking. "On the house. Don't tell anyone."

b: ^ "The carters have stopped taking the long way round the barrows since you started going down. That's worth a mug."

maudry_greet_fallen: ^Maudry looks past you at the door, then back. "No
^"Take them to the Shrine of the Ember. They raise the ones who fell down there. Cheaper than a funeral, and they complain less after."
maudry_news: ^"The barrows are open again. Not dug open. Open. And the ones inside are the walking kind now."
^"Somebody sent to Greyholt for help. Lord Pellam sent back a letter. Three pages. I read it twice and I still couldn't tell you if it was a yes."
^"Osric Hale posts a bounty when the Watch has the coin, which is about never. So it's you, I suppose. Nobody else is coming."
maudry_hire: ^"Sellswords drink here. Some of them even pay. The board by the door says who's looking for work and what they cost."

b: ^ "You've company enough already, mind. I'll not have a crowd blocking my door."

maudry_hire: ^"There's usually a Grey Sister in the corner, too. Takes coin for the road like anyone else. Don't let the vestments fool you. She swings that mace like she means it."
maudry_barrows: ^"Old mounds, out past the fields. From when there was an empire to bury people in."
^"They march down there, you know. In step. Like somebody's still calling it."
^"You find anything with writing on it, bring it up. Somebody ought to be reading it."
maudry_town: ^"The Crossed Keys, if you want a bed and don't mind the stairs. Hale & Daughter for anything that needs mending. It's the daughter you want."
^"Wendel's for rope and bread. His lamp oil's gone up a copper again. He blames the roads. I blame Wendel."
^"And the Shrine of the Ember. They raise the ones who fell. You'll get to know them, I expect. Everyone does."

s1: ^"Wipe your boots on the way out, not the way in."
s2: ^"Come back in one piece. The pieces are harder to serve."
